stories.title: Allowlist Configuration Management and Enforcement
stories.description: Implement a centralized allowlist configuration for permitted tools, ensuring only explicitly registered tools can be invoked and blocking any unauthorized tool_use requests at runtime.

stories.title: Structured Error Handling for Tool Validation Failures
stories.description: Add standardized error handling and response formatting for schema validation failures and disallowed tool calls, ensuring safe and consistent feedback to the agent loop.

stories.title: Tool Invocation Audit Logging
stories.description: Extend debug logging to capture tool routing decisions, including selected tool, validation status, and rejection reasons, enabling traceability and debugging.

stories.title: Multi-Tool Conflict Resolution Strategy
stories.description: Implement deterministic handling for cases where multiple tool_use blocks are returned, including prioritization or rejection rules aligned with allowlist constraints.
